title: centaurea microcephala
intro: Centaurea microcephala, commonly known as the Alpine knapweed, is a flowering plant native to the mountainous regions of Europe. The plant is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce stress and improve overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Centaurea microcephala include its ability to soothe digestive issues, reduce anxiety, and promote relaxation, making it a popular natural remedy for various health concerns. Bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
